questions.stem: What is the correct order of the classification hierarchy from largest to smallest group?

options.text: Species, Genus, Family, Order, Class, Phylum, Kingdom
Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species
Kingdom, Species, Genus, Family, Order, Class, Phylum
Phylum, Kingdom, Class, Order, Family, Species, Genus

questions.explanation: The correct order from largest to smallest is Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species. A useful mnemonic is King Philip Came Over For Good Spaghetti.
